relations.evidence: You can use optimizer hints to request that the [optimizer](cost-based-optimizer.md) should consider specific indexes, join methods, join ordering, and so on, when creating the plan for a query.

notable_absence.finding: The hint-comment syntax itself carries no access-control gate - it is a query-text feature layered onto whichever statement it decorates (SELECT/DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE), so any privilege requirement belongs to the underlying statement, not to the hint syntax. This is consistent with query-hints.json and other pure-syntax pages in this batch.

cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known issue in docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: 'In Couchbase Server 8.0 and later, a hint comment is supported in SELECT, DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE statements only.' - a literal 'Couchbase Server 8.0' version-gate citation on a Capella page, despite Capella having no discrete version numbers.
